text: Educational Objectives This program prepares undergraduates with an extensive and solid background in flight vehicle systems, structure, aerodynamics, and guidance and control. Students will have expertise in the system analysis, overall design, and parametric designof flight vehicle systems. Program Outcomes The undergraduates are qualified to work in areas related with aeronautics and astronautics science and technology, such as aircraft design, flight vehicle guidance and control, flight dynamics, structure analysis and design, aerodynamic characteristics analysis and the design of aircraft. The future major employers could be industrial enterprises, research institutes, and other companies related to theoretical research, experimental research, technology development and technology management in the areas of aeronautics and astronautics science and technology. Duration and Degree 4 years, Bachelor Degree in Engineering
